title: Research sprint goal: Benchmark knowledge scenarios: a scenario question set and kb content for absent questions
goal: The sprint goal's open questions are answered from official sources (Microsoft Learn first, kb tools first, live docs for the gaps) and written as kb facts through the kb skills, FSMO role transfer and seizure with Move-ADDirectoryServerOperationMasterRole being present in the kb with a pack of coverage good, no check: line and a lead article on FSMO; DHCP failover between two Windows Server DHCP servers (load balance and hot standby modes, MCLT, Add-DhcpServerv4Failover) is present in the kb with such a pack; SQL Server Always On availability group automatic seeding (SEEDING_MODE, the CREATE ANY DATABASE grant on the secondary, its monitoring views) is present in the kb with such a pack. Leave unresearched, since the benchmark asks them as not-present rows: Okta as an external identity provider for Entra ID, the tempdb data file count, Exchange Online retention policies with Purview, Hyper-V Replica, Microsoft 365 E5 prices.

run: import subprocess,sys,re;t=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'_tools/rag.py','pack',sys.argv[1]],capture_output=True,text=True).stdout;head=t.split('\n## ')[0];h=re.search(r'^## (.+)',t,re.M);print(t.splitlines()[0] if t else 'no pack');print(h.group(1) if h else 'no article');sys.exit(0 if t.startswith('coverage: good') and 'check:' not in head and h and re.search(sys.argv[2],h.group(1),re.I) else 1)
